# Exception

<link-summary>The base of the hierarchy, extending Error.</link-summary>

<web-summary>Exception — The base of the hierarchy, extending Error. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>exception</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
class Exception extends Error
```

The base of the hierarchy, extending `Error`. Catch this to catch everything the library throws and nothing else.

Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.

## Examples

### Throwing and catching

```javascript
throw new Exception("something specific about this call");

try {
  doWork();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof Exception) {
    // handled
  }
}
```
